label: 自転車をこいでいる青いパーカーの男の子
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve children's illustration cutout. Image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: the short tousled brown-haired boy wearing a BLUE zip-front hoodie, cream shirt, brown eyes, warm expressive face. Image 2 is POSE/BICYCLE/ART STYLE reference. Create ONE boy pedaling a bicycle toward SCREEN RIGHT, replacing the girl rider in image 2 with this SAME BOY. Match image 1 face and haircut faithfully, blue hoodie with cream drawstrings, cream shirt; tan knee-length shorts, white socks, simple sneakers to complete the boy's outfit. No girl, skirt, star hairclip or ponytail. Cheerful natural smile and forward gaze. Full rider and ENTIRE light-blue bicycle including front wire basket, two complete circular wheels, spokes, frame, chain guard, pedals and feet. Natural hands gripping handlebars and both feet contacting pedals, believable cycling posture. Match warm watercolor/gouache children's book painting, delicate textured colors, soft fine brown outlines, gentle natural child proportions. Square composition at the same scale as the existing bicycle cutout, clear transparent margins so no hair, fingers or wheels are cut off. Genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, including all empty spaces inside spoke gaps, basket mesh and frame. NO scenery, white rectangle, printed checkerboard, colored flecks/park residue, cast shadow, text, calendar, speech bubble or extra people. A single reusable isolated boy-and-bicycle PNG asset.
